title: U Turskoj pao vojni helikopter, poginula četiri vojnika
Military helicopter crashes in Turkey, four soldiers killed
body: U Turskoj se u četvrtak srušio vojni helikopter, a sva četiri vojnika u njemu su poginula.
A military helicopter crashed in Turkey on Thursday, and all four soldiers on board were killed.
Nesreća se dogodila oko 18:45 po lokalnom vremenu, u selu Samankoy u provinciji Malatya.
The accident happened at around 18:45 local time, in the village of Samankoy in Malatya province.
U BiH je tada bilo 16:45.
In BiH it was 16:45 at the time.
Helikopter tipa S-70 bio je na zadatku i pripadao je jednom puku kopnene vojske.
The S-70 helicopter was on a mission and belonged to an army regiment.
Nakon pada izbio je požar, koji je zahvatio i jednu kuću u blizini.
After the crash a fire broke out, which also spread to a nearby house.
Vatrogasci su ugasili vatru, a na mjesto su stigle i hitna pomoć i turska služba za katastrofe.
Firefighters put out the fire, and ambulances and the Turkish disaster service also arrived at the scene.
Turski mediji objavili su i snimak nesreće.
Turkish media also published a video of the accident.
Tursko ministarstvo odbrane saopćilo je da uzrok nesreće još nije poznat.
The Turkish defence ministry said that the cause of the accident is not yet known.
Ministarstvo je izrazilo saučešće porodicama poginulih vojnika, ali njihova imena još nisu objavljena.
The ministry expressed condolences to the families of the killed soldiers, but their names have not yet been published.
Policija i vojska sada istražuju šta se dogodilo.
The police and the army are now investigating what happened.

title: KK Bosna zbog bazara vjerovatno igra na Grbavici
Because of a bazaar, KK Bosna will probably play at Grbavica
body: Košarkaši Bosne BH Telecom vjerovatno će jednu utakmicu ABA lige igrati izvan dvorane Zetra.
The basketball players of Bosna BH Telecom will probably play one ABA League game outside the Zetra arena.
Protiv Ilirije u 9. kolu trebali bi igrati u dvorani "Goran Čengić" na Grbavici.
They should play against Ilirija in round 9 in the "Goran Čengić" hall at Grbavica.
Razlog je Diplomatski zimski bazar, koji počinje u Zetri u subotu u 11 sati.
The reason is the Diplomatic Winter Bazaar, which starts in Zetra on Saturday at 11 o'clock.
Bosna u nedjelju u Zetri dočekuje Megu, a sljedeće sedmice igra dvije utakmice.
On Sunday, Bosna hosts Mega in Zetra, and next week it plays two games.
U srijedu, 18. novembra, igra protiv Lietkabelisa u Eurocupu.
On Wednesday, 18 November, it plays against Lietkabelis in the Eurocup.
Utakmica s Ilirijom bila je planirana za sljedeći dan, ali je pomjerena na petak, jer su dvije utakmice zaredom preteške za igrače.
The game with Ilirija was planned for the next day, but it was moved to Friday, because two games in a row are too hard for the players.
ABA liga je utakmicu zakazala za 20 sati.
The ABA League scheduled the game for 20:00.
Štandovi za bazar moraju se postaviti dan ranije, pa Zetra u petak navečer neće biti slobodna.
The stalls for the bazaar must be set up a day earlier, so Zetra will not be free on Friday evening.
Na stranici ABA lige kao mjesto utakmice već piše dvorana na Grbavici.
The ABA League website already lists the hall at Grbavica as the venue of the game.
Ipak, Klix.ba navodi da bi se mjesto još moglo promijeniti.
However, Klix.ba states that the venue could still change.

title: Tarantino otkrio da je prije snimanja otpustio dvije glumice
Tarantino reveals he fired two actresses before filming
body: Režiser Quentin Tarantino otkrio je da je prije snimanja filma "Nemilosrdni gadovi" otpustio dvije glumice.
Director Quentin Tarantino has revealed that he fired two actresses before shooting the film "Inglourious Basterds".
O tome govori u novoj knjizi Jaya Glenniea o nastanku filma.
He talks about it in a new book by Jay Glennie about the making of the film.
Film je izašao 2009. godine i zaradio je 321 milion dolara.
The film came out in 2009 and earned 321 million dollars.
Prva je bila Mélanie Laurent, koja je loše odigrala prvo čitanje scenarija.
The first was Mélanie Laurent, who performed badly at the first reading of the script.
Nekoliko dana kasnije nazvala je Tarantina i ponudila da sama plati put i hotel kako bi dobila novu priliku.
A few days later she called Tarantino and offered to pay for the trip and hotel herself to get a new chance.
Režiser je pristao, a nakon tri dana proba vratio joj je ulogu Shosanne.
The director agreed, and after three days of rehearsals he gave her back the role of Shosanna.
Isabelle Huppert nije došla na čitanje, a bilo je i problema s njenim ugovorom, pa je ulogu dobila Maggie Cheung.
Isabelle Huppert did not come to the reading, and there were also problems with her contract, so Maggie Cheung got the role.
Na kraju su sve scene s tim likom izbačene iz filma.
In the end, all scenes with that character were cut from the film.
Tarantino je rekao da glumcima ne duguje ništa, ali da filmu duguje najbolje glumce koje može naći.
Tarantino said that he owes the actors nothing, but that he owes the film the best actors he can find.
Za Laurent je dodao da je odlično odigrala ulogu.
About Laurent he added that she played the role excellently.

title: Vijeće ministara zaustavilo saradnju škola s NASA-om
Council of Ministers stops schools' cooperation with NASA
body: Vijeće ministara BiH na današnjoj sjednici nije prihvatilo prijedlog za sporazum s američkom svemirskom agencijom NASA.
At today's session, the BiH Council of Ministers did not accept the proposal for an agreement with the American space agency NASA.
Sporazum je trebalo da potpiše Ministarstvo civilnih poslova BiH.
The agreement was to be signed by the BiH Ministry of Civil Affairs.
Zbog toga škole iz BiH zasad neće službeno učestvovati u programu GLOBE.
Because of this, schools from BiH will not officially take part in the GLOBE programme for now.
GLOBE je međunarodni obrazovni i naučni program koji podržava NASA.
GLOBE is an international educational and scientific programme supported by NASA.
On povezuje škole, učenike, nastavnike i naučnike u više od 125 zemalja.
It connects schools, pupils, teachers and scientists in more than 125 countries.
Učenici u programu prate okoliš i klimatske promjene, a podatke dijele s naučnicima širom svijeta.
Pupils in the programme monitor the environment and climate change, and share data with scientists around the world.
Nastavnici dobijaju dodatnu obuku i nove metode rada.
Teachers get extra training and new working methods.
Ministarstvo je pokrenulo ovaj proces jer želi da škole iz cijele BiH uđu u mrežu.
The ministry started this process because it wants schools from all of BiH to join the network.
U članku nije navedeno zašto je Vijeće ministara odbilo prijedlog.
The article does not state why the Council of Ministers rejected the proposal.
Iz ministarstva su poručili da će nastaviti raditi kako bi škole i naučne institucije mogle ući u međunarodne programe.
The ministry said that it will continue working so that schools and scientific institutions can join international programmes.

title: Upozorenje na poplave u slivu Une i Bosne
Flood warning for the Una and Bosna river basins
body: Agencija za vodno područje rijeke Save izdala je upozorenje na poplave za dijelove BiH.
The Sava River Basin Water Agency has issued a flood warning for parts of BiH.
Vanredno stanje na rijekama važi od 13. do 15. novembra, a odnosi se na slivove Une i Bosne.
The state of emergency on the rivers applies from 13 to 15 November, and it covers the Una and Bosna basins.
Sliv je područje s kojeg voda teče u jednu rijeku.
A basin is the area from which water flows into one river.
Prognoze najavljuju jaku kišu i vjetar, posebno u Hercegovini i jugozapadnoj Bosni.
Forecasts announce heavy rain and wind, especially in Herzegovina and south-western Bosnia.
Zbog toga bi manji potoci mogli brzo nabujati, a u gradovima su moguće poplave ulica.
Because of this, smaller streams could swell quickly, and street flooding is possible in towns.
Najveći rast vode očekuje se na rijekama Sani i Sanici, a zatim na Uni.
The biggest rise in water is expected on the Sana and Sanica rivers, and then on the Una.
U slivu Bosne voda bi brže mogla rasti na Fojničkoj rijeci, Zujevini i Željeznici.
In the Bosna basin, the water could rise faster on the Fojnička rijeka, Zujevina and Željeznica.
U 17 sati nijedna stanica u BiH nije bila u stanju odbrane od poplava.
At 17:00, no station in BiH was in a state of flood defence.
Ipak, Una kod Martin Broda porasla je za 22 centimetra za 24 sata.
However, the Una at Martin Brod rose by 22 centimetres in 24 hours.
Najveći rast u zemlji imala je Neretva u Mostaru, čak 142 centimetra.
The Neretva in Mostar had the biggest rise in the country, as much as 142 centimetres.

title: Instruktori: Automatik je lakši, ali vozači se previše opuste
Instructors: An automatic is easier, but drivers relax too much
body: Instruktori vožnje kažu da je auto s automatskim mjenjačem jednostavniji za vožnju od auta s ručnim mjenjačem.
Driving instructors say that a car with an automatic gearbox is easier to drive than a car with a manual gearbox.
Vozač ne mora mijenjati brzine ni koristiti kvačilo, pa više pažnje može dati saobraćaju.
The driver does not have to change gears or use a clutch, so they can pay more attention to traffic.
Ipak, upozoravaju da to može stvoriti lažan osjećaj sigurnosti.
However, they warn that this can create a false sense of safety.
Česta greška je kočenje lijevom nogom, jer vozači navikli na kvačilo nesvjesno pritisnu pedalu.
A common mistake is braking with the left foot, because drivers used to a clutch press the pedal without thinking.
Tako mogu naglo zakočiti, što je opasno za vozila iza njih.
That way they can brake suddenly, which is dangerous for the vehicles behind them.
Instruktori savjetuju da se gas i kočnica pritišću samo desnom nogom.
Instructors advise that the accelerator and brake should be pressed only with the right foot.
Prije polaska treba provjeriti je li izabrano R ili D, kako auto ne bi krenuo u pogrešnom smjeru.
Before setting off, you should check whether R or D is selected, so that the car does not move in the wrong direction.
Obje ruke trebaju biti na volanu, a ne na ručici mjenjača.
Both hands should be on the steering wheel, not on the gear lever.
Kod parkiranja prvo treba povući ručnu kočnicu, a tek onda izabrati P.
When parking, you should first pull the handbrake, and only then select P.
Instruktori zaključuju da lakša vožnja ne znači da vozač smije biti manje pažljiv.
The instructors conclude that easier driving does not mean that the driver may be less careful.

title: Putopisac šokiran cijenama hrane na aerodromu u Istanbulu
Travel writer shocked by food prices at Istanbul airport
body: Bosanskohercegovački putopisac Robert Dacešin objavio je video s aerodroma u Istanbulu.
Bosnian travel writer Robert Dacešin has published a video from Istanbul airport.
Na snimku pokazuje cijene hrane i pića, koje su mnoge ljude iznenadile.
In the video he shows the prices of food and drinks, which surprised many people.
Dacešin na društvenim mrežama često dijeli zanimljivosti s putovanja.
Dacešin often shares interesting facts from his travels on social media.
Sendvič na aerodromu košta 14,50 eura, a kroasan 6,50 eura.
A sandwich at the airport costs 14.50 euros, and a croissant 6.50 euros.
Bagete se prodaju od 8 eura, a čokolada za 40 eura.
Baguettes sell from 8 euros, and chocolate for 40 euros.
Kilogram tradicionalnog turskog slatkiša, lokuma, košta čak 120 eura.
A kilogram of the traditional Turkish sweet, lokum, costs as much as 120 euros.
Aerodrom je u evropskom dijelu grada i mnogi putnici tu presjedaju.
The airport is in the European part of the city, and many passengers change planes there.
Dacešin je rekao da tu presjeda desetak puta godišnje i da je svaki put sve skuplje.
Dacešin said that he changes planes there about ten times a year and that it gets more expensive every time.
Napisao je da ne zna postoji li na svijetu trenutno skuplje mjesto.
He wrote that he does not know whether there is a more expensive place in the world right now.
Mnogi pratioci složili su se s njim, a neki su napisali da hranu uvijek nose od kuće.
Many followers agreed with him, and some wrote that they always bring food from home.

title: Schmidt: Pitanje secesije RS-a još nije završeno
Schmidt: The question of RS secession is not over yet
body: Bivši visoki predstavnik Christian Schmidt govorio je u Berlinu o stanju u Bosni i Hercegovini.
Former High Representative Christian Schmidt spoke in Berlin about the situation in Bosnia and Herzegovina.
Diskusija je održana u Evropskoj kući, blizu Brandenburške kapije, a tema je bio Dejtonski sporazum.
The discussion was held in the European House, near the Brandenburg Gate, and the topic was the Dayton Agreement.
Schmidt je ovog ljeta napustio funkciju nakon pritiska iz SAD-a.
Schmidt left the post this summer after pressure from the USA.
Rekao je da pitanje secesije Republike Srpske nije potpuno skinuto s dnevnog reda.
He said that the question of the secession of Republika Srpska has not been completely removed from the agenda.
Prema njegovim riječima, postojao je ozbiljan rizik da se referendum o nezavisnosti RS-a održi već 2027. godine.
According to him, there was a serious risk that a referendum on the independence of RS would be held as early as 2027.
Ipak, on ne vjeruje da bi stanovnici RS-a podržali takav referendum.
However, he does not believe that the residents of RS would support such a referendum.
Schmidt misli da je secesija manje vjerovatna nakon promjena u Srbiji.
Schmidt thinks that secession is less likely after the changes in Serbia.
Dodao je da je BiH još daleko od članstva u Evropskoj uniji.
He added that BiH is still far from membership in the European Union.
Niels von Redecker iz njemačkog ministarstva vanjskih poslova rekao je da BiH nije ni u drugoj, nego tek u trećoj grupi kandidata.
Niels von Redecker from the German foreign ministry said that BiH is not even in the second, but only in the third group of candidates.
Ambasador BiH u Njemačkoj Damir Arnaut rekao je da mnogi političari ne žele EU, jer bi tada mogli završiti pod istragom.
The BiH ambassador to Germany, Damir Arnaut, said that many politicians do not want the EU, because then they could end up under investigation.

title: Novi krvni test mogao bi rano otkriti rak jajnika
New blood test could detect ovarian cancer early
body: Američki naučnici razvili su krvni test koji bi mogao otkriti rane promjene prije raka jajnika.
American scientists have developed a blood test that could detect early changes before ovarian cancer.
Istraživanje je vodio institut Hoag u Kaliforniji, a rezultati su objavljeni u časopisu Nature Medicine.
The research was led by the Hoag institute in California, and the results were published in the journal Nature Medicine.
Test još nije odobren i pacijentima zasad nije dostupan.
The test has not yet been approved and is not available to patients for now.
Test mjeri u krvi jednu molekulu koja je povišena kod žena s ranim promjenama u jajovodu.
The test measures one molecule in the blood which is raised in women with early changes in the fallopian tube.
Te promjene ne vide se na snimanju ni na običnim krvnim nalazima.
These changes cannot be seen on scans or in ordinary blood results.
Test je otkrio promjene kod 92,3 posto žena koje su ih imale.
The test detected the changes in 92.3 percent of women who had them.
Kod zdravih žena tačan rezultat dao je u 98,2 posto slučajeva.
In healthy women, it gave a correct result in 98.2 percent of cases.
Doktor Rajan Gogna rekao je da rak jajnika ne počinje onog dana kada se otkrije tumor.
Doctor Rajan Gogna said that ovarian cancer does not begin on the day when a tumour is found.
Glavna istraživačica Esha Madan vjeruje da bi test mogao pomoći ženama s visokim rizikom.
The lead researcher, Esha Madan, believes that the test could help women at high risk.
Naučnici sada planiraju nova istraživanja, jer su do sada analizirali samo starije uzorke krvi.
The scientists are now planning new studies, because so far they have only analysed older blood samples.

title: BH Fanaticosi pozivaju navijače da u Solnu dođu u crnom
BH Fanaticos call on fans to come to Solna in black
body: Navijačka grupa BH Fanaticos pozvala je navijače BiH na zajednički marš do stadiona u Solni.
The fan group BH Fanaticos has called BiH fans to a joint march to the stadium in Solna.
Reprezentacija BiH u subotu igra protiv Švedske u Ligi nacija.
The BiH national team plays against Sweden in the Nations League on Saturday.
Navijači trebaju doći obučeni u crno, jer će i grupa nositi crnu odjeću.
Fans should come dressed in black, because the group will also wear black clothes.
Poziv je objavljen na Facebook stranici "Operacija Stockholm".
The call was published on the Facebook page "Operacija Stockholm".
Mjesto i vrijeme okupljanja biće objavljeni na dan utakmice.
The meeting place and time will be announced on the day of the match.
Svih 52.000 ulaznica je prodano, a sektor za gostujuće navijače je pun.
All 52,000 tickets have been sold, and the section for away fans is full.
Utakmica počinje u 20:45, a pobjeda bi Zmajeve dovela na prvo mjesto u grupi.
The match starts at 20:45, and a win would take the Dragons to first place in the group.
Grupa podsjeća da u Švedskoj živi mnogo ljudi porijeklom iz BiH, a hiljade će doći i iz drugih zemalja.
The group reminds that many people of BiH origin live in Sweden, and thousands will also come from other countries.
Od navijača traže da budu glasni, ali i dostojanstveni.
They ask fans to be loud, but also dignified.
Sličan marš organizovali su u oktobru u Zenici, kada su BiH i Švedska igrale 1:1.
They organised a similar march in October in Zenica, when BiH and Sweden played 1:1.
Švedski selektor Graham Potter rekao je da očekuje mnogo navijača BiH na tribinama.
Swedish head coach Graham Potter said that he expects many BiH fans in the stands.

title: Katić: Muharemović je među pet najboljih stopera svijeta
Katić: Muharemović is among the five best centre-backs in the world
body: Štoper reprezentacije BiH Nikola Katić rekao je da je subotnja utakmica protiv Švedske najvažnija u ovom dijelu Lige nacija.
BiH national team centre-back Nikola Katić said that Saturday's match against Sweden is the most important in this part of the Nations League.
Zmajevi igraju u Solni kod Stockholma, a tri dana kasnije dočekuju Rumuniju u Zenici.
The Dragons play in Solna near Stockholm, and three days later they host Romania in Zenica.
Jedna pobjeda donosi drugo mjesto, a dvije pobjede prvo mjesto u grupi.
One win brings second place, and two wins first place in the group.
Katić kaže da Švedska ima brze igrače s mnogo kvaliteta.
Katić says that Sweden has fast players with a lot of quality.
Ipak, smatra da i BiH ima talentovane igrače i da će igrati bez straha.
Still, he thinks that BiH also has talented players and that they will play without fear.
Na utakmici neće igrati Tarik Muharemović, jer ima previše žutih kartona.
Tarik Muharemović will not play in the match, because he has too many yellow cards.
Katić je rekao da je to veliki gubitak i da je Muharemović možda među pet najboljih štopera na svijetu.
Katić said that this is a big loss and that Muharemović may be among the five best centre-backs in the world.
Dodao je da će ostali odbrambeni igrači dobro odraditi posao.
He added that the other defenders will do the job well.
Edin Džeko, koji se u oktobru oprostio od reprezentacije, doći će na utakmicu da podrži tim.
Edin Džeko, who said goodbye to the national team in October, will come to the match to support the team.
Katić je rekao da se on i Džeko stalno čuju i da će ga biti teško zamijeniti.
Katić said that he and Džeko talk all the time and that he will be hard to replace.
Katić ima ugovor sa Schalkeom do ljeta 2028. godine.
Katić has a contract with Schalke until the summer of 2028.

title: Preminuo Steve Connors, fotoreporter iz opkoljenog Sarajeva
Steve Connors, photojournalist from besieged Sarajevo, has died
body: Preminuo je britanski fotoreporter i dokumentarista Steve Connors, koji je snimao opkoljeno Sarajevo tokom rata.
British photojournalist and documentary maker Steve Connors, who photographed besieged Sarajevo during the war, has died.
Vijest je objavio Sniper Alley, arhiv fotografija i svjedočenja fotografa iz vremena opsade.
The news was announced by Sniper Alley, an archive of photographs and testimonies of photographers from the time of the siege.
Na Instagramu su ga nazvali dragim prijateljem i izuzetnim čovjekom.
On Instagram they called him a dear friend and an exceptional man.
Napisali su i da ga Bosanci nikada neće zaboraviti.
They also wrote that Bosnians will never forget him.
Connors je rođen u Sheffieldu, na sjeveru Engleske.
Connors was born in Sheffield, in the north of England.
Bio je vojni policajac u britanskoj vojsci, gdje je sam naučio fotografisati.
He was a military policeman in the British army, where he taught himself to take photographs.
Kasnije je izvještavao iz bivše Jugoslavije, Afganistana, Iraka, Čečenije, Ukrajine i drugih zemalja.
Later he reported from the former Yugoslavia, Afghanistan, Iraq, Chechnya, Ukraine and other countries.
Njegove fotografije objavljivali su Time, Newsweek, Der Spiegel i The Guardian.
His photographs were published by Time, Newsweek, Der Spiegel and The Guardian.
Pomogao je osnovati neprofitnu novinsku organizaciju Orb Media.
He helped found the non-profit news organisation Orb Media.
Godine 2007. s novinarkom Molly Bingham snimio je dokumentarni film "Meeting Resistance" o ratu u Iraku.
In 2007, with journalist Molly Bingham, he made the documentary film "Meeting Resistance" about the war in Iraq.
Za taj film proveli su deset mjeseci s pobunjenicima u Bagdadu.
For that film they spent ten months with insurgents in Baghdad.

title: Simulacija: BiH bi mogla igrati s Engleskom i Španijom
Simulation: BiH could play England and Spain
body: Portal Football Meets Data objavio je simulaciju žrijeba za kvalifikacije za Svjetsko prvenstvo 2030. godine.
The portal Football Meets Data published a simulation of the draw for the 2030 World Cup qualifiers.
Po toj simulaciji, BiH bi bila u grupi od 12 reprezentacija, među kojima su Engleska, Španija, Italija i Hrvatska.
According to that simulation, BiH would be in a group of 12 national teams, including England, Spain, Italy and Croatia.
To nije zvanični žrijeb, nego samo primjer kako bi grupa mogla izgledati.
It is not an official draw, but only an example of how the group could look.
To će biti prve kvalifikacije po novom formatu UEFA-e, koji je predstavljen u maju.
These will be the first qualifiers under UEFA's new format, which was presented in May.
Svih 54 evropske reprezentacije biće podijeljene u dvije lige, prema rezultatima u Ligi nacija.
All 54 European national teams will be divided into two leagues, according to their results in the Nations League.
U prvoj ligi su 36 timova u tri grupe od po 12, a svaki tim igra šest utakmica.
The first league has 36 teams in three groups of 12, and each team plays six matches.
Pobjednici tih grupa direktno idu na Svjetsko prvenstvo.
The winners of those groups go directly to the World Cup.
Timovi iz druge lige mogu se plasirati samo kroz baraž.
Teams from the second league can qualify only through the playoffs.
Bit će manje utakmica, ali mnogo više susreta jakih reprezentacija.
There will be fewer matches, but many more meetings of strong national teams.
BiH više ne bi igrala protiv San Marina, Andore ili Gibraltara.
BiH would no longer play against San Marino, Andorra or Gibraltar.
Predsjednik UEFA-e Aleksander Čeferin rekao je da će novi format smanjiti broj utakmica u kojima se ništa ne odlučuje.
UEFA President Aleksander Čeferin said that the new format would reduce the number of matches in which nothing is decided.

title: WhatsApp testira poruke koje nestaju nakon čitanja
WhatsApp tests messages that disappear after reading
body: WhatsApp testira opciju "View Once" i za tekstualne poruke.
WhatsApp is testing the "View Once" option for text messages too.
Takva poruka može se pročitati samo jednom, a nakon toga nestaje.
Such a message can be read only once, and after that it disappears.
Prema portalu WABetaInfo, opcija je sada dostupna nekim korisnicima beta verzije za Android.
According to the portal WABetaInfo, the option is now available to some users of the beta version for Android.
Ova opcija već postoji za fotografije, video snimke i glasovne poruke.
This option already exists for photos, videos and voice messages.
Da bi poslao takvu poruku, korisnik treba duže držati dugme za slanje i izabrati "View Once".
To send such a message, the user needs to hold the send button longer and choose "View Once".
Primalac poruku otvara u posebnom prozoru, a kada ga zatvori, ne može je ponovo otvoriti.
The recipient opens the message in a separate window, and when they close it, they cannot open it again.
Poruka se ne može kopirati ni proslijediti, a aplikacija blokira snimke ekrana.
The message cannot be copied or forwarded, and the app blocks screenshots.
Ipak, sadržaj se i dalje može fotografisati kamerom drugog telefona.
However, the content can still be photographed with the camera of another phone.
Ni WhatsApp ni pošiljalac to ne mogu spriječiti.
Neither WhatsApp nor the sender can prevent that.
Zasad nije poznato kada će nova opcija biti dostupna svim korisnicima.
For now it is not known when the new option will be available to all users.

title: Poništen tender od 34 miliona KM za zidove protiv buke
A 34-million-KM tender for noise walls is cancelled
body: Tender za gradnju zidova protiv buke na autoputu A1 između Drivuše i Visokog je poništen.
The tender for building noise walls on the A1 motorway between Drivuša and Visoko has been cancelled.
Odluku je donio Ured za razmatranje žalbi, nakon što je neko podnio žalbu.
The decision was made by the Appeals Review Office, after someone filed a complaint.
Tender je raspisala firma JP Autoceste FBiH krajem juna.
The tender was announced by the company JP Autoceste FBiH at the end of June.
Posao je bio vrijedan 29 miliona KM bez PDV-a, odnosno skoro 34 miliona KM s PDV-om.
The job was worth 29 million KM without VAT, or almost 34 million KM with VAT.
Ugovor bi trajao tri godine, a pobijedila bi firma s najnižom cijenom.
The contract would last three years, and the company with the lowest price would win.
Nije poznato ko je podnio žalbu i da li će biti raspisan novi tender.
It is not known who filed the complaint or whether a new tender will be announced.
Istog dana raspisan je i tender za nadzor radova, vrijedan 702.000 KM s PDV-om.
On the same day a tender for supervising the works, worth 702,000 KM with VAT, was also announced.
Dionica Drivuša–Visoko otvorena je 2005. godine bez zidova protiv buke.
The Drivuša–Visoko section opened in 2005 without noise walls.
Firma kaže da tada zakon nije tražio da se misli na buku.
The company says that the law at that time did not require thinking about noise.
Zidovi bi pomogli stanovnicima naselja kao što su Arnautovići, Kalotići i Čifluk.
The walls would help residents of settlements such as Arnautovići, Kalotići and Čifluk.
Autoceste FBiH su ove godine poništile 37 od 199 svojih nabavki.
Autoceste FBiH has cancelled 37 of its 199 procurements this year.

title: Goran Milić: Hrvati u Čileu i BiH žive bolje od većine
Goran Milić: Croats in Chile and BiH live better than the majority
body: Hrvatski novinar Goran Milić rekao je da postoje samo dvije zemlje u kojima Hrvati kao manjina žive bolje od većine.
Croatian journalist Goran Milić said there are only two countries where Croats as a minority live better than the majority.
To su, kako je rekao, Čile i Bosna i Hercegovina.
These are, as he said, Chile and Bosnia and Herzegovina.
Milić je bio gost podcasta Kliker, gdje je govorio o Hrvatima u Južnoj Americi.
Milić was a guest on the Kliker podcast, where he talked about Croats in South America.
Rekao je da su Hrvati u Čileu u prosjeku bogatiji od Čileanaca španskog i italijanskog porijekla.
He said that Croats in Chile are on average richer than Chileans of Spanish and Italian origin.
Kao primjer je naveo da su Hrvati bili predsjednici Čilea, a neki su danas senatori.
As an example he mentioned that Croats have been presidents of Chile, and some are senators today.
Trener Mirko Jozić donio je Čileu najveći nogometni uspjeh, a aerodrom je projektovao hrvatski arhitekt.
Coach Mirko Jozić brought Chile its greatest football success, and the airport was designed by a Croatian architect.
U Argentini su Hrvati također uspješni, ali ne kao u Čileu.
In Argentina Croats are also successful, but not like in Chile.
Prema Miliću, Hrvati u Njemačkoj i Americi bogatiji su od Hrvata u Hrvatskoj.
According to Milić, Croats in Germany and America are richer than Croats in Croatia.
Ipak, nisu bogatiji od Nijemaca ili Amerikanaca.
However, they are not richer than Germans or Americans.
Za BiH je rekao da je to jedina druga zemlja gdje najmanji narod ima bolji položaj od najvećeg.
About BiH he said that it is the only other country where the smallest people has a better position than the largest.
Njegove riječi izazvale su mnogo komentara na portalu.
His words caused many comments on the portal.

title: Stranke se bore za tri ministarstva u Vijeću ministara
Parties fight over three ministries in the Council of Ministers
body: Stranke koje žele formirati novu vlast na nivou BiH još nisu sjele za zajednički sto.
The parties that want to form the new state-level government have not yet sat down at a common table.
Do sada su održani samo odvojeni sastanci, između HDZ-a i SNSD-a, te Dragana Čovića s liderima SDA i SDP-a.
So far there have only been separate meetings, between HDZ and SNSD, and between Dragan Čović and the leaders of SDA and SDP.
Konkretnog dogovora o podjeli ministarstava zasad nema.
There is no concrete agreement on dividing the ministries for now.
Prema nezvaničnim informacijama, SNSD i partneri traže četiri ministarstva, ali bi prihvatili i tri.
According to unofficial information, SNSD and its partners are asking for four ministries, but would also accept three.
HDZ želi tri, a SDA i njeni partneri bi dobili dva ili tri ministarstva i mjesto predsjedavajućeg.
HDZ wants three, while SDA and its partners would get two or three ministries and the post of chairman.
Najveća borba očekuje se oko ministarstava vanjskih poslova, finansija i vanjske trgovine.
The biggest fight is expected over the ministries of foreign affairs, finance and foreign trade.
Vanjske poslove žele i SDA i HDZ, dok SNSD želi zadržati finansije.
Both SDA and HDZ want foreign affairs, while SNSD wants to keep finance.
Za vanjsku trgovinu, koju sada vodi Staša Košarac iz SNSD-a, zanima se i SDA.
SDA is also interested in foreign trade, which is now run by Staša Košarac of SNSD.
Ministarstvo odbrane bi, kako se očekuje, trebalo pripasti SDA.
The Ministry of Defence is expected to go to SDA.
Prema nepisanom pravilu, predsjedavajući bi sada trebao doći iz probosanskog bloka.
According to an unwritten rule, the chairman should now come from the pro-Bosnian bloc.
Prethodni predsjedavajući bili su Zoran Tegeltija iz SNSD-a i Borjana Krišto iz HDZ-a.
The previous chairs were Zoran Tegeltija of SNSD and Borjana Krišto of HDZ.
Konačan dogovor zavisi od toga koliko su stranke spremne na kompromis.
The final agreement depends on how ready the parties are to compromise.

title: Kako mozak nauči voljeti kafu i drugu hranu
How the brain learns to love coffee and other food
body: Naučnici s Univerziteta Kalifornije u San Franciscu otkrili su kako mozak polako uči voljeti određenu hranu.
Scientists from the University of California, San Francisco have discovered how the brain slowly learns to love certain food.
Istraživanje je 4. novembra objavljeno u časopisu Nature.
The research was published on 4 November in the journal Nature.
Važnu ulogu ima dopamin, hemijska tvar u mozgu koja je povezana s nagradom i učenjem.
An important role is played by dopamine, a chemical in the brain that is linked to reward and learning.
Kada hrana dođe u crijeva, ona šalju mozgu informaciju o šećeru i masti.
When food reaches the gut, it sends the brain information about sugar and fat.
Tada se dopamin oslobađa polako, nekoliko minuta, a mi to ne primjećujemo.
Then dopamine is released slowly, for several minutes, and we do not notice it.
Profesor Zachary Knight objasnio je da kafa postaje ugodna kada mozak poveže njen okus s djelovanjem kofeina.
Professor Zachary Knight explained that coffee becomes pleasant when the brain links its taste with the effect of caffeine.
U eksperimentima su miševi prestali učiti koji okus donosi kalorije kada su naučnici prekinuli taj put.
In experiments, mice stopped learning which taste brings calories when the scientists interrupted that pathway.
Slični rezultati dobijeni su i kod ljudi, a reakcija je bila jača u lijevoj strani mozga.
Similar results were also found in people, and the reaction was stronger in the left side of the brain.
Naučnici kažu da bi se jednog dana moglo mijenjati koliko volimo određenu hranu.
Scientists say that one day it might be possible to change how much we like certain food.
Knight smatra da lijekovi GLP-1, koji smanjuju apetit, možda slabe ovaj signal.
Knight thinks that GLP-1 drugs, which reduce appetite, may weaken this signal.
Ipak, to istraživanje nije provjeravalo, pa je to zasad samo pretpostavka.
However, the research did not test that, so for now it is only an assumption.

title: Garza prvi put u petorci, Boston slavio u Torontu
Garza in the starting five for the first time, Boston wins in Toronto
body: Bosanskohercegovački centar Luka Garza prvi put je ove sezone počeo utakmicu u prvoj petorci Boston Celticsa.
Bosnian-Herzegovinian centre Luka Garza started a game in the Boston Celtics' starting five for the first time this season.
Boston je u Torontu nadoknadio minus od 22 poena i pobijedio Raptorse rezultatom 98:93.
In Toronto Boston made up a 22-point deficit and beat the Raptors 98:93.
Trener Joe Mazzulla igrao je s dva centra, Garzom i Neemiasom Quetom, jer je Paul George bio bolestan.
Coach Joe Mazzulla played with two centres, Garza and Neemias Queta, because Paul George was ill.
Garza je za 11 minuta postigao 5 poena i imao jedan skok.
Garza scored 5 points in 11 minutes and had one rebound.
Prije ove utakmice prosječno je postizao 6,5 poena, a imao je i najbolji šut za tri poena u timu.
Before this game he averaged 6.5 points, and he also had the best three-point shooting on the team.
Jayson Tatum je 25 sekundi prije kraja pogodio dva slobodna bacanja i donio Bostonu vodstvo.
Jayson Tatum made two free throws 25 seconds before the end and gave Boston the lead.
Tatum je završio s 24 poena, a Boston sada ima pet pobjeda zaredom i omjer 10-2.
Tatum finished with 24 points, and Boston now has five wins in a row and a 10-2 record.
Garza je rekao da mu igra s dva centra daje još jednu priliku da dobije minute.
Garza said that playing with two centres gives him one more chance to get minutes.
Dodao je da želi potpuno prihvatiti tu ulogu.
He added that he wants to fully accept that role.
Iste noći San Antonio je pobijedio Chicago, a Victor Wembanyama postigao je 32 poena.
The same night San Antonio beat Chicago, and Victor Wembanyama scored 32 points.
Stephen Curry povrijedio se u prvoj četvrtini i nije se vratio u igru.
Stephen Curry got injured in the first quarter and did not return to the game.

title: Scarlett Johansson otvoreno o lošim ponudama iz Hollywooda
Scarlett Johansson speaks openly about bad offers from Hollywood
body: Glumica Scarlett Johansson rekla je da joj veliki holivudski studiji ponekad nude čudne projekte.
Actress Scarlett Johansson said that big Hollywood studios sometimes offer her strange projects.
Kod nekih filmova pita se zašto ih uopće snimaju.
With some films she wonders why they are being made at all.
To je rekla u intervjuu za Los Angeles Times, dok je promovisala nezavisnu dramu „Paper Tiger“.
She said this in an interview with the Los Angeles Times, while she was promoting the independent drama "Paper Tiger".
Producentima je rekla da bi snimanje takvih filmova bilo neodgovorno.
She told producers that making such films would be irresponsible.
Kada bira ulogu, pita se da li pravi nešto što drugi ljudi žele gledati.
When she chooses a role, she asks herself whether she is making something other people want to watch.
Nije rekla koji su je studiji razočarali.
She did not say which studios had disappointed her.
Film „Paper Tiger“ kupila je kompanija Neon prije premijere na festivalu u Cannesu.
The film "Paper Tiger" was bought by the company Neon before its premiere at the festival in Cannes.
Johansson je poznata po ulozi Crne udovice u Marvelovim filmovima.
Johansson is known for the role of Black Widow in the Marvel films.
Uskoro će glumiti u novom filmu reditelja Arija Astera „Scapegoat“, s Judeom Lawom.
She will soon act in director Ari Aster's new film "Scapegoat", with Jude Law.
Kaže da je scenarij vrlo intenzivan i da je dok ga je čitala stalno govorila „O, Bože!“.
She says that the script is very intense and that while she was reading it she kept saying "Oh, God!".

title: Duratović: SNSD bi mogao dobiti petog delegata u Domu naroda
Duratović: SNSD could get a fifth delegate in the House of Peoples
body: Mirsad Duratović, poslanik SDP-a u Narodnoj skupštini RS-a, upozorio je da u opoziciji ima „spavača“.
Mirsad Duratović, an SDP deputy in the RS National Assembly, warned that there are "sleepers" in the opposition.
Tako on naziva ljude koji tajno rade protiv jedinstva opozicije.
That is what he calls people who secretly work against the unity of the opposition.
Zbog njih bi SNSD i partneri mogli dobiti petog delegata u Domu naroda Parlamentarne skupštine BiH.
Because of them, SNSD and its partners could get a fifth delegate in the House of Peoples of the Parliamentary Assembly of BiH.
Duratović je to rekao u utorak uveče u emisiji „Plenum“ na Federalnoj televiziji.
Duratović said this on Tuesday evening on the programme "Plenum" on Federal Television.
Prije četiri godine SNSD je dobio četvrtog delegata, a krivica je prebačena na bošnjačke poslanike.
Four years ago SNSD got a fourth delegate, and the blame was shifted to the Bosniak deputies.
Duratović kaže da su oni tada glasali za svog kandidata, a da su krivi bili „preletači“ i svađa između SDS-a i PDP-a.
Duratović says they voted for their own candidate at the time, and that "defectors" and the quarrel between SDS and PDP were to blame.
Prema nekim informacijama, vladajuća koalicija sada bi mogla imati 57 ili 58 poslanika u skupštini.
According to some reports, the ruling coalition could now have 57 or 58 deputies in the assembly.
Neki poslanici čija se imena spominju rekli su da ne prelaze na drugu stranu.
Some deputies whose names are mentioned have said that they are not switching sides.
Duratović je rekao da je petak „pazarni dan“ u Banjoj Luci, kada se mogu praviti dogovori.
Duratović said that Friday is "market day" in Banja Luka, when deals can be made.
Dodao je da će stvari biti jasnije nakon ponedjeljka.
He added that things will be clearer after Monday.
SDP neće podržati kandidate SDS-a ni SNSD-a, ali konačnu odluku još nije donio.
SDP will not support SDS or SNSD candidates, but it has not yet made a final decision.
Stranka bi mogla imati svog kandidata ili ne bi glasala.
The party could have its own candidate or not vote.

title: Narandžasto upozorenje zbog jakog vjetra u BiH
Orange warning for strong wind in BiH
body: U BiH je danas upaljen narandžasti meteoalarm zbog jakog i olujnog vjetra.
An orange weather alert for strong and stormy wind has been issued in BiH today.
Upozorenje počinje u 12 sati i traje do petka, 13. novembra, u 9 sati.
The warning starts at 12 o'clock and lasts until Friday, 13 November, at 9 o'clock.
Federalni hidrometeorološki zavod očekuje udare vjetra od 60 do 80 kilometara na sat, a lokalno i do 90.
The Federal Hydrometeorological Institute expects wind gusts of 60 to 80 kilometres per hour, and locally up to 90.
Danas će biti pretežno oblačno, uz slabu kišu i lokalne pljuskove.
Today will be mostly cloudy, with light rain and local showers.
Jutarnja temperatura bit će od 11 do 17, a dnevna od 16 do 22 stepena.
The morning temperature will be from 11 to 17, and the daytime temperature from 16 to 22 degrees.
U Sarajevu se ujutro očekuje oko 12, a tokom dana oko 18 stepeni.
In Sarajevo about 12 degrees is expected in the morning, and about 18 during the day.
Za petak je izdato i upozorenje za obilnu kišu u Hercegovini i jugozapadnoj Bosni, gdje može pasti od 40 do 80 litara po kvadratnom metru.
For Friday a warning for heavy rain has also been issued in Herzegovina and southwestern Bosnia, where 40 to 80 litres per square metre may fall.
Civilna zaštita Kantona Sarajevo savjetuje građanima da s balkona sklone stvari koje vjetar može odnijeti.
Sarajevo Canton civil protection advises citizens to remove things from their balconies that the wind could carry away.
Automobile ne treba parkirati blizu velikih stabala, a izlete u prirodu treba odgoditi.
Cars should not be parked near large trees, and trips into nature should be postponed.
U subotu dolazi primjetno zahlađenje, a u višim dijelovima Bosne očekuje se snijeg.
On Saturday a noticeable cold spell arrives, and snow is expected in the higher parts of Bosnia.
Dnevna temperatura tada će biti od 2 do 8 stepeni, na jugu do 13.
The daytime temperature will then be from 2 to 8 degrees, up to 13 in the south.

title: Gardista se srušio dok je Macron dočekivao slovačkog predsjednika
A guardsman collapsed while Macron was welcoming the Slovak president
body: Pripadnik počasne garde srušio se u srijedu ispred Elizejske palate u Parizu.
A member of the guard of honour collapsed on Wednesday in front of the Élysée Palace in Paris.
To se desilo dok je francuski predsjednik Emmanuel Macron dočekivao slovačkog predsjednika Petera Pellegrinija.
It happened while French President Emmanuel Macron was welcoming Slovak President Peter Pellegrini.
Snimak je objavila slovačka televizija TV JOJ, a dalje ga je poslala agencija Reuters.
The footage was published by Slovak television TV JOJ, and the Reuters agency distributed it further.
Na snimku se vidi kako Pellegrinijev automobil dolazi pred palatu.
The footage shows Pellegrini's car arriving in front of the palace.
Malo kasnije jedan gardista, koji je stajao pored stepenica, pao je na tlo.
A little later one guardsman, who was standing next to the stairs, fell to the ground.
Do njega su odmah došli članovi osoblja, a prišao mu je i Macron.
Staff members went to him immediately, and Macron also approached him.
Osoblje ga je zatim odnijelo sa stepenica.
The staff then carried him away from the stairs.
Nakon toga Macron je pozdravio Pellegrinija i dvojica predsjednika ušla su u zgradu.
After that Macron greeted Pellegrini and the two presidents entered the building.
Nije poznato zašto se gardista srušio.
It is not known why the guardsman collapsed.
TV JOJ je javila da se još ne zna ni kako se on sada osjeća.
TV JOJ reported that it is also not yet known how he is feeling now.

title: Odbor Nvidije možda smjenjuje šefa Jensena Huanga
Nvidia's board may remove its boss Jensen Huang
body: Upravni odbor kompanije Nvidia sprema se smijeniti direktora Jensena Huanga, piše Wall Street Journal.
Nvidia's board of directors is preparing to remove CEO Jensen Huang, the Wall Street Journal writes.
Razlog su dvije afere, odnosno dvije ljubavne veze izvan braka.
The reason is two affairs, that is, two romantic relationships outside marriage.
Članovi odbora sastali su se u srijedu uveče po američkom vremenu, ali odluka do kasno u noć nije objavljena.
The board members met on Wednesday evening US time, but no decision had been announced by late at night.
New York Times piše da je Huang imao vezu s Kimberly Powell, potpredsjednicom kompanije koja radi direktno za njega.
The New York Times writes that Huang had a relationship with Kimberly Powell, a company vice president who works directly for him.
U nedjelju je priznao i vezu s Alice Huang, koju američke službe smatraju kineskom špijunkom, što Kina negira.
On Sunday he also admitted a relationship with Alice Huang, whom US agencies consider a Chinese spy, which China denies.
Huang ima 63 godine i vodi Nvidiju od njenog osnivanja 1993. godine.
Huang is 63 years old and has led Nvidia since it was founded in 1993.
On ima oko 3,6 posto dionica, pa ga odbor od 11 članova može smijeniti običnom većinom.
He owns about 3.6 percent of the shares, so the 11-member board can remove him by a simple majority.
Prema portalu Semafor, neki članovi odbora žele da finansijska direktorica Colette Kress privremeno preuzme kompaniju.
According to the Semafor website, some board members want CFO Colette Kress to take over the company temporarily.
Bloomberg javlja da Nvidia s vanjskom agencijom već traži novog direktora.
Bloomberg reports that Nvidia is already looking for a new CEO with an outside agency.
Nakon ovih vijesti cijena dionica Nvidije pala je za skoro 9 posto.
After this news, the price of Nvidia shares fell by almost 9 percent.

title: Demokrata Scott Colom pobijedio na izborima u Mississippiju
Democrat Scott Colom wins the election in Mississippi
body: Demokrata Scott Colom pobijedio je na izborima za senatora američke savezne države Mississippi.
Democrat Scott Colom has won the election for senator of the US state of Mississippi.
Pobijedio je republikansku senatorku Cindy Hyde-Smith, objavila je agencija Associated Press.
He defeated Republican senator Cindy Hyde-Smith, the Associated Press agency reported.
Prema CNN-u, on je prvi demokrata kojeg je Mississippi poslao u Senat nakon više od 40 godina.
According to CNN, he is the first Democrat whom Mississippi has sent to the Senate in more than 40 years.
Kada je prebrojano oko 99 posto glasova, Colom je imao 473.336 glasova, odnosno 49,2 posto.
When about 99 percent of the votes had been counted, Colom had 473,336 votes, or 49.2 percent.
Hyde-Smith je dobila 468.667 glasova, a nezavisni kandidat Ty Pinkins 20.234.
Hyde-Smith received 468,667 votes, and independent candidate Ty Pinkins 20,234.
Izbori su bili 3. novembra, ali rezultat danima nije bio siguran.
The election was on 3 November, but the result was uncertain for days.
Hyde-Smith je na Facebooku napisala da njen tim ne odustaje.
Hyde-Smith wrote on Facebook that her team is not giving up.
Colom je tužilac u sjevernom Mississippiju, a 2023. ga je Joe Biden predložio za saveznog sudiju.
Colom is a prosecutor in northern Mississippi, and in 2023 Joe Biden nominated him to be a federal judge.
Hyde-Smith je tada blokirala njegovo imenovanje, a kasnije se time hvalila u kampanji.
Hyde-Smith blocked his appointment at the time, and later boasted about it in her campaign.
Većina analitičara mislila je da republikanci ne mogu izgubiti ovo mjesto.
Most analysts thought that the Republicans could not lose this seat.
Colom će biti prvi Afroamerikanac koji predstavlja Mississippi u Senatu nakon 19. stoljeća.
Colom will be the first African American to represent Mississippi in the Senate since the 19th century.

title: Šta je samrtni hropac i zašto se javlja
What the death rattle is and why it happens
body: Neki ljudi u posljednjim satima ili danima života dišu uz vlažan, grgljajući zvuk.
Some people in the last hours or days of life breathe with a wet, gurgling sound.
Taj zvuk zove se samrtni hropac, a ljekari ga nazivaju terminalnim respiratornim sekretom.
This sound is called the death rattle, and doctors call it terminal respiratory secretions.
Porodicama je teško slušati ga, ali prema medicinskim saznanjima vjerovatno ne izaziva bol.
It is hard for families to listen to, but according to medical knowledge it probably does not cause pain.
Prema američkom Nacionalnom institutu za rak, pljuvačka i druge tečnosti skupljaju se u grlu.
According to the US National Cancer Institute, saliva and other fluids collect in the throat.
Zdrava osoba ih proguta ili iskašlje, ali umiruća osoba to više ne može, pa zrak prolazi kroz tečnost.
A healthy person swallows them or coughs them up, but a dying person can no longer do that, so air passes through the fluid.
Zvuk može biti tih kao jecanje ili glasan kao hrkanje.
The sound can be quiet like moaning or loud like snoring.
Portal Healthline navodi da osoba nakon pojave hropca živi u prosjeku oko 23 sata, ali to je različito.
The Healthline website states that after the rattle appears a person lives about 23 hours on average, but this varies.
Stručnjaci kažu da to nije isto što i nedostatak zraka.
Experts say that this is not the same as a lack of air.
Stanje se može olakšati ako se osoba okrene na bok i ako se višak tečnosti ukloni iz usta.
The condition can be eased if the person is turned onto their side and if excess fluid is removed from the mouth.
Pomaže i kada se smanji unos tečnosti.
It also helps when fluid intake is reduced.

title: EU želi zabraniti skrivene ručke na vratima automobila
The EU wants to ban hidden handles on car doors
body: Evropska unija mogla bi zabraniti uvučene ručke na vratima automobila, kao što je već uradila Kina.
The European Union could ban recessed handles on car doors, as China has already done.
Prema prijedlogu, vrata putničkih automobila i lakih dostavnih vozila uvijek bi se morala moći otvoriti mehanički.
According to the proposal, the doors of passenger cars and light delivery vehicles would always have to be able to be opened mechanically.
To bi važilo i za otvaranje iznutra i za otvaranje izvana.
This would apply both to opening from the inside and to opening from the outside.
Mnogi proizvođači posljednjih godina mijenjaju klasične ručke modernim rješenjima.
In recent years many manufacturers have been replacing classic handles with modern solutions.
Takve ručke nisu uvijek jednostavne za korištenje, a neke su izazvale i teške povrede.
Such handles are not always easy to use, and some have even caused serious injuries.
U nesreći mogu postati smrtonosna zamka, posebno ručke koje rade na struju.
In an accident they can become a deadly trap, especially handles that work on electricity.
Kineske vlasti već su postrožile pravila o tome kako ručke moraju izgledati.
Chinese authorities have already tightened the rules on how handles must look.
EU bi mogla uvesti i sistem koji osigurava da nijedno dijete ne ostane zaključano u automobilu.
The EU could also introduce a system that ensures that no child is left locked in a car.
O prijedlogu će se glasati do kraja ove godine.
The proposal will be voted on by the end of this year.
Ako bude usvojen, o njemu će se zatim pregovarati sa zemljama članicama.
If it is adopted, it will then be negotiated with the member states.

title: Novi mural u Istočnom Sarajevu prikazuje popa Žuću
New mural in East Sarajevo shows pop Žućo
body: Na jednoj stambenoj zgradi u Istočnom Novom Sarajevu nedavno je naslikan novi mural.
A new mural was recently painted on a residential building in East Novo Sarajevo.
Zgrada je blizu parka Gavrilo Princip, a mural govori o takozvanom egzodusu Srba iz Sarajeva od 1992. do 1996. godine.
The building is near Gavrilo Princip park, and the mural is about the so-called exodus of Serbs from Sarajevo from 1992 to 1996.
Na njemu je pravoslavni sveštenik Vojislav Čarkić, poznat kao pop Žućo.
On it is the Orthodox priest Vojislav Čarkić, known as pop Žućo.
Tokom rata Čarkić je nosio uniformu i komandovao četničkim odredom na Grbavici.
During the war Čarkić wore a uniform and commanded a Chetnik unit in Grbavica.
Klix piše da je blagosiljao topove i minobacače koji su svaki dan granatirali Sarajevo.
Klix writes that he blessed the cannons and mortars which shelled Sarajevo every day.
U opsadi grada ubijeno je 1.601 dijete.
1,601 children were killed in the siege of the city.
Njegov dolazak u Sarajevo 2021. godine, tokom posjete patrijarha Porfirija, izazvao je veliko negodovanje.
His arrival in Sarajevo in 2021, during the visit of Patriarch Porfirije, caused great outrage.
Klix piše da su priču o egzodusu opovrgnuli historijski dokumenti i presude Haškog tribunala.
Klix writes that the story of the exodus has been refuted by historical documents and judgments of the Hague Tribunal.
Prema tim izvorima, Srbi nisu bili protjerani, nego je preseljenje početkom 1996. organizovalo rukovodstvo sa Pala.
According to those sources, the Serbs were not expelled, but the relocation in early 1996 was organized by the leadership in Pale.
SDS je tada širio strah i ljudima davao autobuse i kamione za odlazak.
At that time the SDS spread fear and gave people buses and trucks to leave.
Zato Klix mural vidi kao prekrajanje historije.
That is why Klix sees the mural as a rewriting of history.

title: Dua Lipa, Tame Impala i SZA predvode Coachellu 2027.
Dua Lipa, Tame Impala and SZA lead Coachella 2027
body: Organizatori festivala Coachella objavili su u srijedu imena izvođača za 2027. godinu.
The organizers of the Coachella festival announced the names of the performers for 2027 on Wednesday.
Glavne zvijezde bit će Dua Lipa, Tame Impala i SZA, a svako od njih predvodit će jednu večer.
The main stars will be Dua Lipa, Tame Impala and SZA, and each of them will lead one evening.
Festival se održava u kalifornijskoj pustinji, u gradu Indio.
The festival is held in the Californian desert, in the town of Indio.
Coachella traje dva vikenda po 3 dana, od 9. do 11. i od 16. do 18. aprila.
Coachella lasts two weekends of 3 days each, from 9 to 11 and from 16 to 18 April.
Tame Impala je bio glavna zvijezda i 2019. godine.
Tame Impala was also a headliner in 2019.
Tada je Kevin Parker postao prvi Australac koji je predvodio festival.
Then Kevin Parker became the first Australian to headline the festival.
Dua Lipa je na Coachelli nastupila 2017. godine s Martinom Garrixom.
Dua Lipa performed at Coachella in 2017 with Martin Garrix.
Prvi put će nastupiti Daddy Yankee, koji je prošlog mjeseca objavio novi album.
Daddy Yankee will perform for the first time, who released a new album last month.
Na listi su i Madonna, Weezer, Robyn, Måneskin, Kygo i mnogi drugi.
Also on the list are Madonna, Weezer, Robyn, Måneskin, Kygo and many others.
Ulaznice se počinju prodavati u petak.
Tickets go on sale on Friday.
Vijest je prenijela agencija AP.
The news was reported by the AP agency.

title: Kakav je Zlatan Ibrahimović kao otac na treningu
What Zlatan Ibrahimović is like as a father at training
body: Novinar Luigi Garlando ispričao je priču o Zlatanu Ibrahimoviću u jednom podcastu.
Journalist Luigi Garlando told a story about Zlatan Ibrahimović on a podcast.
Garlando je zajedno sa Zlatanom napisao njegovu knjigu Adrenalina.
Garlando wrote his book Adrenalina together with Zlatan.
Porodica Ibrahimović bila je na jahti na Ibizi, a Zlatan se vratio s treninga sav znojan.
The Ibrahimović family was on a yacht in Ibiza, and Zlatan came back from training all sweaty.
Probudio je sinove Maximiliana i Vincenta i odveo ih na trening bez doručka.
He woke his sons Maximilian and Vincent and took them to training without breakfast.
Bilo je vruće, pa je mlađem Vincentu bilo teško, dok je stariji Maximilian sve završio.
It was hot, so the younger Vincent had a hard time, while the older Maximilian finished everything.
Vincent je povratio, ali ga je otac natjerao da trči još jednom.
Vincent vomited, but his father made him run once more.
Zlatan mu je onda rekao da uvijek možeš još malo, čak i kada misliš da više ne možeš.
Zlatan then told him that you can always do a little more, even when you think you can't anymore.
Garlando je rekao da Zlatan nije htio tu priču u knjizi.
Garlando said that Zlatan did not want that story in the book.
U šali mu je rekao da će mu oduzeti švedsko državljanstvo ako je objavi.
He jokingly told him that he would take away his Swedish citizenship if he published it.
Ipak, Zlatan je pustio sinove da sami otkriju fudbal i nije im stalno dolazio na treninge.
However, Zlatan let his sons discover football themselves and did not keep coming to their training sessions.
Danas obojica igraju fudbal na visokom nivou.
Today both of them play football at a high level.
vocab: to force, to make (someone do something)

title: Alajbegović fotografisan kamerom staroj 129 godina
Alajbegović photographed with a 129-year-old camera
body: Juventus je na Facebooku objavio crno-bijele portrete svojih igrača.
Juventus published black-and-white portraits of its players on Facebook.
Fotografije su snimljene kamerom koja je stara 129 godina, isto koliko i klub.
The photos were taken with a camera that is 129 years old, the same age as the club.
Juventus je osnovan 1897. godine.
Juventus was founded in 1897.
Među igračima je i bh. reprezentativac Kerim Alajbegović.
Among the players is also the Bosnia and Herzegovina international Kerim Alajbegović.
Na slici se smiješi u tamnoj jakni ispred bijelog zida.
In the picture he smiles in a dark jacket in front of a white wall.
Klub je uz fotografije napisao: Stari objektiv, bezvremenske boje.
Alongside the photos the club wrote: Old lens, timeless colours.
Alajbegović ima 19 godina i igra kao krilo, a nosi broj 17.
Alajbegović is 19 years old and plays as a winger, and he wears number 17.
U Juventus je došao u augustu iz Bayer Leverkusena.
He came to Juventus in August from Bayer Leverkusen.
Do sada je odigrao 10 utakmica u Seriji A, ukupno 470 minuta.
So far he has played 10 matches in Serie A, a total of 470 minutes.
Za to vrijeme postigao je 1 gol i dao 1 asistenciju.
In that time he scored 1 goal and made 1 assist.
Rođen je 2007. godine u Kölnu, a prije je igrao i za Red Bull Salzburg.
He was born in 2007 in Cologne, and he previously also played for Red Bull Salzburg.

title: Pandurević isključena iz SDS-a, traži smjenu Blanuše
Pandurević removed in SDS, demands Blanuša's dismissal
body: Predsjednik SDS-a Branko Blanuša isključio je Aleksandru Pandurević iz Glavnog odbora stranke.
SDS president Branko Blanuša has removed Aleksandra Pandurević from the party's Main Board.
Iz odbora su isključena i još 3 delegata iz Bijeljine.
Three more delegates from Bijeljina were also removed from the board.
Pandurević kaže da je ta odluka diktatorska i da je protiv statuta stranke.
Pandurević says that this decision is dictatorial and against the party statute.
Blanuša se pozvao na pravilo po kojem predsjednik može sam izabrati 26 članova odbora.
Blanuša referred to a rule by which the president can choose 26 board members himself.
Pandurević tvrdi da nijedno pravilo ne dozvoljava isključenje članova.
Pandurević claims that no rule allows members to be removed.
Ona misli da Blanuša želi osigurati većinu u odboru i mjesto u Domu naroda BiH.
She thinks that Blanuša wants to secure a majority on the board and a seat in the House of Peoples of BiH.
Prema njenim riječima, Blanuša je napravio tajni dogovor sa Miloradom Dodikom i SNSD-om.
According to her, Blanuša made a secret deal with Milorad Dodik and the SNSD.
Ona tvrdi da bi Bijeljina pripala SNSD-u, a SDS bi zauzvrat dobio podršku za mjesto delegata.
She claims that Bijeljina would go to the SNSD, and in return the SDS would get support for a delegate seat.
Gradonačelnik Bijeljine Ljubiša Petrović i delegati iz tog grada protiv su dogovora sa Dodikom.
The mayor of Bijeljina, Ljubiša Petrović, and the delegates from that city are against deals with Dodik.
Pandurević je najavila inicijativu da se Blanuša smijeni i isključi iz stranke.
Pandurević announced an initiative to dismiss Blanuša and expel him from the party.
Rekla je da njihova borba tek počinje.
She said that their fight is only beginning.

title: Erdogan se u Antaliji sastao s Bećirovićem i Komšićem
Erdogan met Bećirović and Komšić in Antalya
body: Turski predsjednik Recep Tayyip Erdogan sastao se u srijedu u Antaliji s Denisom Bećirovićem i Željkom Komšićem.
Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan met Denis Bećirović and Željko Komšić in Antalya on Wednesday.
Bećirović je predsjedavajući, a Komšić član Predsjedništva BiH.
Bećirović is the chairman, and Komšić a member of the BiH Presidency.
Sastanak je bio tokom samita lidera na COP31, konferenciji UN-a o klimatskim promjenama.
The meeting was during the leaders' summit at COP31, the UN conference on climate change.
Gosti iz BiH zahvalili su Erdoganu na tradicionalno toplom gostoprimstvu.
The guests from BiH thanked Erdogan for the traditionally warm hospitality.
Čestitali su Turskoj jer je uspješno organizovala konferenciju, na koju su došle desetine hiljada ljudi iz cijelog svijeta.
They congratulated Turkey because it successfully organized the conference, which tens of thousands of people from all over the world came to.
Obje strane su potvrdile da žele jačati saradnju u svim oblastima.
Both sides confirmed that they want to strengthen cooperation in all areas.
Posebno su govorili o političkoj i ekonomskoj saradnji.
They spoke especially about political and economic cooperation.
Odnose dvije zemlje opisali su kao prijateljske i kao snažno partnerstvo.
They described the relations between the two countries as friendly and as a strong partnership.
Rekli su da je važno nastaviti politički dijalog i češće organizovati posjete na najvišem nivou.
They said that it is important to continue the political dialogue and to organize visits at the highest level more often.
Na sastanku je bio i turski ministar vanjskih poslova Hakan Fidan.
Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan was also at the meeting.
Informacije je objavilo Predsjedništvo BiH.
The information was published by the BiH Presidency.

title: Dodik već 17 dana nije bio u Srbiji
Dodik has not been to Serbia for 17 days
body: Milorad Dodik je ranije gotovo svake sedmice dolazio u Beograd.
Milorad Dodik used to come to Belgrade almost every week.
Od izbora u Srbiji 25. oktobra nije bio tamo već 17 dana.
Since the election in Serbia on 25 October, he has not been there for 17 days.
Te noći bio je pored Aleksandra Vučića, kada je njegova stranka izgubila vlast nakon 14 godina.
That night he was beside Aleksandar Vučić, when his party lost power after 14 years.
Vučić je tada rekao da će se uskoro vidjeti promjene u odnosima prema Republici Srpskoj i Sarajevu.
Vučić said then that changes in relations towards Republika Srpska and Sarajevo would soon be seen.
Dodik se posljednji put sa Vučićem sastao 11. oktobra u jednom beogradskom restoranu.
Dodik last met Vučić on 11 October in a Belgrade restaurant.
U Srbiji je za dvije sedmice uhapšeno više od 90 ljudi, javio je Al Jazeera Balkans.
More than 90 people have been arrested in Serbia in two weeks, Al Jazeera Balkans reported.
Među njima su visoki policajci, bankari i direktori javnih preduzeća, a u srijedu je na aerodromu uhapšen i bivši ministar Rade Basta.
Among them are senior police officers, bankers and directors of public companies, and on Wednesday former minister Rade Basta was also arrested at the airport.
Neki od uhapšenih godinama su bili dio Vučićevog sistema vlasti.
Some of those arrested were part of Vučić's system of power for years.
Zato Klix pita da li Dodik izbjegava Srbiju jer se boji hapšenja.
That is why Klix asks whether Dodik is avoiding Serbia because he is afraid of arrest.
Za Dan primirja 11. novembra Dodik nije otišao u Beograd, nego je čestitke poslao iz Banje Luke.
For Armistice Day on 11 November, Dodik did not go to Belgrade, but sent his greetings from Banja Luka.
On je čestitao pobjedu Studentskoj listi i rekao da će Republika Srpska i Srbija nastaviti saradnju.
He congratulated the Student List on its victory and said that Republika Srpska and Serbia would continue cooperation.

title: Sony isporučio više od 100 miliona konzola PlayStation 5
Sony has shipped more than 100 million PlayStation 5 consoles
body: Sony je do 10. novembra isporučio više od 100 miliona konzola PlayStation 5.
By 10 November Sony had shipped more than 100 million PlayStation 5 consoles.
To je četvrta Sonyjeva konzola koja je prešla tu granicu, nakon PS1, PS2 i PS4.
It is the fourth Sony console to pass that mark, after the PS1, PS2 and PS4.
PS5 je izašao 12. novembra 2020., pa uskoro slavi 6 godina.
The PS5 came out on 12 November 2020, so it will soon celebrate 6 years.
Broj pokazuje koliko je konzola poslano prodavnicama, a ne koliko su ih kupci kupili.
The number shows how many consoles were sent to shops, not how many customers bought.
Krajem septembra Sony je imao 97,9 miliona isporučenih konzola.
At the end of September Sony had 97.9 million shipped consoles.
Za nešto više od mjesec dana poslano je još najmanje 2,1 milion, i to prije izlaska igre GTA 6 19. novembra.
In just over a month at least 2.1 million more were sent, ahead of the release of the game GTA 6 on 19 November.
Ipak, prodaja je sporija nego ranije, jer je od jula do septembra isporučeno 2,6 miliona, a godinu prije 4 miliona.
However, sales are slower than before, because 2.6 million were shipped from July to September, compared with 4 million a year earlier.
Najbolja godina za PS5 bila je od aprila 2023. do marta 2024., s 20,8 miliona konzola.
The best year for the PS5 was from April 2023 to March 2024, with 20.8 million consoles.
Najprodavanija Sonyjeva konzola i dalje je PS2, s više od 160 miliona.
Sony's best-selling console is still the PS2, with more than 160 million.
Sony procjenjuje da PlayStation svaki mjesec koristi 127 miliona ljudi.
Sony estimates that 127 million people use PlayStation every month.

title: Sarajevske stranke se dogovorile: nova skupština u petak
Sarajevo parties agreed: new assembly on Friday
body: Predstavnici šest stranaka sastali su se u srijedu u zgradi Skupštine Kantona Sarajevo.
Representatives of six parties met on Wednesday in the building of the Sarajevo Canton Assembly.
Za istim stolom bili su i buduća vlast i buduća opozicija.
Both the future government and the future opposition were at the same table.
Razgovarali su o konstituirajućoj sjednici, to jest o prvoj sjednici nove skupštine.
They talked about the constituent session, that is, about the first session of the new assembly.
Na sastanku su bili SDA, DF, NiP, SDP, Stranka za BiH i Naša stranka.
SDA, DF, NiP, SDP, the Party for BiH and Naša stranka were at the meeting.
Sjednica počinje u petak u 08:30, a tada će se izabrati i komisija od 7 članova.
The session starts on Friday at 08:30, and a commission of 7 members will also be chosen then.
U komisiji će biti 4 člana vlasti i 3 člana opozicije.
There will be 4 members of the government and 3 members of the opposition on the commission.
Sjednica će se morati prekinuti jer CIK još nije potvrdio 4 ili 5 mandata.
The session will have to be interrupted because the CEC has not yet confirmed 4 or 5 mandates.
Aljoša Čampara iz NiP-a rekao je da nema nikakve priče o blokadi.
Aljoša Čampara from NiP said that there is no talk at all of a blockade.
Sjednica bi se trebala nastaviti 7 dana kasnije, kada će se birati predsjedavajući skupštine.
The session should continue 7 days later, when the speaker of the assembly will be chosen.
Čampara je rekao da je atmosfera bila konstruktivna i da svi žele brzo formirati novu vladu.
Čampara said that the atmosphere was constructive and that everyone wants to form the new government quickly.
Albin Zuhrić iz DF-a također ne očekuje blokadu.
Albin Zuhrić from DF also does not expect a blockade.

title: U Zagrebu održana komemoracija za Mišu Kovača
Commemoration for Mišo Kovač held in Zagreb
body: U koncertnoj dvorani Vatroslav Lisinski u Zagrebu održana je komemoracija za pjevača Mišu Kovača.
A commemoration for the singer Mišo Kovač was held in the Vatroslav Lisinski concert hall in Zagreb.
Organizovala ju je diskografska kuća Croatia Records.
It was organized by the record company Croatia Records.
Porodica, prijatelji i kolege upisali su se u knjigu žalosti, koja će biti predata porodici.
Family, friends and colleagues signed the book of condolences, which will be handed to the family.
Došla je Kovačeva supruga Lidija s kćerkom Ivanom i unukom Elenom.
Kovač's wife Lidija came with her daughter Ivana and granddaughter Elena.
Bili su tu i muzičari Željko Bebek i Nikša Bratoš.
The musicians Željko Bebek and Nikša Bratoš were also there.
Došli su i hrvatski premijer Andrej Plenković i nekoliko ministara.
The Croatian prime minister Andrej Plenković and several ministers also came.
Pjevač Jacques Houdek rekao je da je Kovač pjesma naše duše i muzika života njegovih roditelja.
The singer Jacques Houdek said that Kovač is the song of our soul and the music of his parents' lives.
Mišo Kovač sahranjen je 4. novembra na zagrebačkom groblju Mirogoj.
Mišo Kovač was buried on 4 November at Zagreb's Mirogoj cemetery.
Sahranjen je pored sina Edija, koji je umro 1992. godine.
He was buried next to his son Edi, who died in 1992.
Dan prije sahrane, ljudi su se od njega oprostili na stadionu Poljud u Splitu.
The day before the funeral, people said goodbye to him at the Poljud stadium in Split.
Svih 33.000 besplatnih ulaznica podijeljeno je za nekoliko sati.
All 33,000 free tickets were handed out in a few hours.

title: Policija zaplijenila ulje za 700 kilograma droge
Police seized oil for 700 kilograms of drugs
body: Federalna uprava policije objavila je u srijedu detalje velike akcije protiv droge pod nazivom „Vrtlog“.
The Federal Police Administration on Wednesday published details of a large anti-drug operation called “Vortex”.
U akciji je uhapšeno 15 osoba iz Sarajeva i Zenice.
In the operation, 15 people from Sarajevo and Zenica were arrested.
Pretresi su bili u tri kantona u Federaciji i u Republici Srpskoj.
The searches were in three cantons in the Federation and in Republika Srpska.
Policija je pronašla 83 litra amfetaminskog ulja, a to je sirovina za proizvodnju droge.
The police found 83 litres of amphetamine oil, which is a raw material for producing drugs.
Iz tog ulja moglo se napraviti između 600 i 700 kilograma amfetamina.
Between 600 and 700 kilograms of amphetamine could have been made from that oil.
Zaplijenjeno je i oko 58 kilograma kanabisa i oko 39 kilograma amfetamina.
About 58 kilograms of cannabis and about 39 kilograms of amphetamine were also seized.
Policajci su oduzeli i nekoliko pištolja, mobitele i vage za drogu.
The police officers also took away several pistols, mobile phones and scales for drugs.
Akciju su vodili policija i MUP Zeničko-dobojskog kantona, uz pomoć obavještajne agencije OSA.
The operation was led by the police and the Interior Ministry of Zenica-Doboj Canton, with help from the intelligence agency OSA.
Osumnjičeni su za organizovani kriminal, prodaju droge i pranje novca.
The suspects are suspected of organized crime, selling drugs and money laundering.
Nakon obrade u policiji, bit će predati Federalnom tužilaštvu.
After processing at the police, they will be handed over to the Federal Prosecutor's Office.
Policija je rekla da istraga još traje.
The police said that the investigation is still going on.

title: CIK podijelio nove mandate u državnom parlamentu
CEC handed out new mandates in the state parliament
body: Centralna izborna komisija BiH dodijelila je nove mandate u državnom parlamentu.
The Central Election Commission of BiH assigned new mandates in the state parliament.
Neki političari ne mogu biti zastupnici jer su ministri ili gradonačelnici.
Some politicians cannot be representatives because they are ministers or mayors.
Zato su svoje mandate stavili u mirovanje, a na njihova mjesta privremeno dolaze drugi.
That is why they put their mandates on hold, and others temporarily take their places.
U Domu naroda četiri delegata su dala ostavku jer su izabrana u Predstavnički dom.
In the House of Peoples, four delegates resigned because they were elected to the House of Representatives.
Na njihova mjesta dolaze Tamara Evđić, Mensur Beganović, Mirnes Gušić i Ivan Vukadin.
Tamara Evđić, Mensur Beganović, Mirnes Gušić and Ivan Vukadin come in their places.
U Predstavničkom domu 10 zastupnika stavilo je mandat u mirovanje.
In the House of Representatives, 10 representatives put their mandate on hold.
Među njima su Zukan Helez iz SDP-a, Draško Stanivuković i Zoran Stevanović.
Among them are Zukan Helez from SDP, Draško Stanivuković and Zoran Stevanović.
CIK je odbio zahtjev Mirne Savić Banjac, jer je rekao da nije osnovan.
The CEC rejected the request of Mirna Savić Banjac, because it said that it was not justified.
Nove mandate dobili su i zastupnici u Narodnoj skupštini Republike Srpske.
Representatives in the National Assembly of Republika Srpska also received new mandates.
Na istoj sjednici CIK je dozvolio nekim strankama da kazne plate u ratama.
At the same session, the CEC allowed some parties to pay fines in instalments.

title: Na Ilidži uhapšena dvojica zbog otmice pet Kineza
Two men arrested in Ilidža over the kidnapping of five Chinese
body: Federalna uprava policije uhapsila je na Ilidži dvojicu državljana Kine.
The Federal Police Administration arrested two citizens of China in Ilidža.
Sumnja se da su oteli pet Kineza dok su ih ilegalno vozili prema Italiji.
They are suspected of kidnapping five Chinese people while they were illegally driving them towards Italy.
Za svakog su tražili 15.000 eura otkupnine i prijetili su im smrću.
They demanded 15,000 euros of ransom for each of them and threatened them with death.
Pretresi su bili 6. novembra po nalogu Suda BiH.
The searches were on 6 November on the order of the Court of BiH.
Policija je oduzela mobitele i novac u različitim valutama.
The police took away mobile phones and money in different currencies.
Prema policiji, žrtve su na putu prema granici bile zatvorene i zlostavljane.
According to the police, the victims were locked up and abused on the way to the border.
Morale su predati novac, a neke su plaćale i preko aplikacija na mobitelu.
They had to hand over money, and some also paid through apps on their phones.
Policija je podnijela prijavu protiv tri osobe, dvojice Kineza i jednog državljanina Pakistana.
The police filed a report against three people, two Chinese men and one citizen of Pakistan.
Sumnjiče se da su organizovali grupu za krijumčarenje migranata, to jest ilegalni prevoz ljudi preko granice.
They are suspected of organizing a group for migrant smuggling, that is, illegally transporting people across the border.
Dvojica uhapšenih predata su Službi za poslove sa strancima.
The two arrested men were handed over to the Service for Foreigners' Affairs.
Policija još traži druge osobe povezane s ovim slučajem.
The police are still looking for other people connected with this case.

title: Uhapšene 11 osoba iz dvije kriminalne grupe
11 people from two criminal groups arrested
body: Policija je u srijedu ujutro uhapsila 11 osoba iz dvije kriminalne grupe.
On Wednesday morning the police arrested 11 people from two criminal groups.
Sumnja se da su prodavali drogu i prali novac.
They are suspected of selling drugs and laundering money.
Među uhapšenima su Muharem Smajlović, Edib Džedžibeg i Selma Bogučanin.
Among those arrested are Muharem Smajlović, Edib Džedžibeg and Selma Bogučanin.
Selma je supruga Amela Bogučanina, kojeg policija već dugo poznaje.
Selma is the wife of Amel Bogučanin, whom the police have known for a long time.
Policija je tražila ukupno 13 osoba, ali je jedna u bolnici, a jedna je pobjegla.
The police were looking for a total of 13 people, but one is in hospital and one has fled.
Pretresi su bili u četiri kantona i u Republici Srpskoj.
The searches were in four cantons and in Republika Srpska.
Tužilaštvo kaže da je od augusta do oktobra zaplijenjeno više od 50 kilograma droge.
The prosecutor's office says that more than 50 kilograms of drugs were seized from August to October.
Klix.ba je saznao da je sve počelo hapšenjem jednog stražara iz zatvora u Zenici.
Klix.ba learned that everything started with the arrest of a guard from the prison in Zenica.
Ibrahim Handanović (29) uhapšen je 22. oktobra nakon potjere.
Ibrahim Handanović (29) was arrested on 22 October after a chase.
Tokom bijega bacio je kroz prozor auta torbu s više od 1 kilograma kanabisa.
During the escape he threw a bag with more than 1 kilogram of cannabis out of the car window.

title: Ko bi mogao biti novi premijer Republike Srpske
Who could be the new prime minister of Republika Srpska
body: Igor Dodik i Zoran Stevanović su najozbiljniji kandidati za novog premijera Republike Srpske.
Igor Dodik and Zoran Stevanović are the most serious candidates for the new prime minister of Republika Srpska.
To je Klix.ba saznao od izvora u Banjoj Luci.
Klix.ba learned this from sources in Banja Luka.
Obojica su iz stranke SNSD.
Both of them are from the SNSD party.
Igor Dodik je organizacioni sekretar SNSD-a i sin predsjednika stranke Milorada Dodika.
Igor Dodik is the organizational secretary of SNSD and the son of the party president Milorad Dodik.
Njega podržavaju mlađi političari i nekoliko općinskih odbora stranke.
He is supported by younger politicians and several municipal boards of the party.
Zoran Stevanović je sada ministar saobraćaja, a ranije je bio gradonačelnik Zvornika.
Zoran Stevanović is now the minister of transport, and earlier he was the mayor of Zvornik.
Njega podržavaju brojni biznismeni iz istočne Bosne.
He is supported by many businessmen from eastern Bosnia.
Obje strane će narednih dana tražiti podršku, ali posljednju riječ bi opet mogao imati Milorad Dodik.
Both sides will look for support in the coming days, but Milorad Dodik could again have the last word.
Novi premijer i nova vlada očekuju se do sredine decembra.
The new prime minister and the new government are expected by mid-December.
Prije toga Željka Cvijanović treba dobiti novi mandat u Predsjedništvu BiH.
Before that, Željka Cvijanović is to get a new term in the Presidency of BiH.
Savo Minić bi trebao postati predsjednik Republike Srpske.
Savo Minić should become the president of Republika Srpska.

title: Čistiji zrak u spavaćoj sobi može pomoći kod šećera
Cleaner air in the bedroom can help with blood sugar
body: Istraživači iz New Yorka otkrili su da prečišćivači zraka u spavaćoj sobi mogu pomoći ljudima s predijabetesom.
Researchers from New York found that air purifiers in the bedroom can help people with prediabetes.
Predijabetes znači da je šećer u krvi viši nego što treba, ali to još nije dijabetes.
Prediabetes means that blood sugar is higher than it should be, but it is not yet diabetes.
Rezultati su predstavljeni 8. novembra.
The results were presented on 8 November.
U istraživanju je bilo više od 150 muškaraca i žena.
More than 150 men and women took part in the study.
Pola njih je mjesec dana spavalo s pravim HEPA filterima, a druga polovina s uređajima koji ne čiste zrak.
Half of them slept for a month with real HEPA filters, and the other half with devices that do not clean the air.
Pravi filteri smanjili su sitne štetne čestice u zraku za 36 posto.
The real filters reduced fine harmful particles in the air by 36 percent.
Kod tih ljudi šećer je nakon doručka bio niži za oko 17 posto.
In these people, sugar after breakfast was about 17 percent lower.
Autorica studije Sharine Wittkopp rekla je da je čišći zrak kod kuće jednostavna i jeftina pomoć.
The study's author Sharine Wittkopp said that cleaner air at home is simple and cheap help.
Ipak, filter ne zamjenjuje zdravu hranu, sport i lijekove.
Still, a filter does not replace healthy food, exercise and medicine.
Jonathan Newman je rekao da rezultati možda ne vrijede za ljude koji već imaju dijabetes.
Jonathan Newman said that the results may not apply to people who already have diabetes.
Tim planira duža istraživanja.
